_comment: MAPLE / NVIDIA GH200 / Mellanox ConnectX InfiniBand / MLX5. v1 hand-written from M1 data; to be replaced by rule-list fitter output after M3 R021 calibration. MLX5 uses QP-per-peer — cap pruning is a no-op (qp_max_per_peer=0 sentinel means 'not cap-bound').

rules._why: All MLX5 paths use GPU-native RDMA via BlueFlame doorbells — no host proxy, no triggered deferral. Tunables degenerate; the ib_native decision is the only meaningful one.
